<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

function vgml_png( $w, $h, $r, $g, $b ) {
    $raw = '';
    for ( $y = 0; $y < $h; $y++ ) {
        $raw .= chr( 0 ) . str_repeat( chr( $r ) . chr( $g ) . chr( $b ), $w );
    }
    $chunk = function ( $type, $data ) {
        return pack( 'N', strlen( $data ) ) . $type . $data . pack( 'N', crc32( $type . $data ) );
    };
    $ihdr = pack( 'NN', $w, $h ) . chr( 8 ) . chr( 2 ) . chr( 0 ) . chr( 0 ) . chr( 0 );
    return "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" . $chunk( 'IHDR', $ihdr ) . $chunk( 'IDAT', gzcompress( $raw, 6 ) ) . $chunk( 'IEND', '' );
}

// Three folders, one nested: Photos, Photos > Harbour, Logos.
$photos  = wp_insert_term( 'Photos', 'media_category' );
$harbour = wp_insert_term( 'Harbour', 'media_category', array( 'parent' => (int) $photos['term_id'] ) );
$logos   = wp_insert_term( 'Logos', 'media_category' );

$dir = wp_upload_dir();

// Four images; three filed (one in the nested folder), one left alone.
$plan = array(
    array( 'Harbour at dusk', (int) $harbour['term_id'], 176, 104, 62 ),
    array( 'Ridgeline study', (int) $photos['term_id'],  92, 118, 92 ),
    array( 'Wordmark, dark',  (int) $logos['term_id'],   31,  56, 100 ),
    array( 'Unfiled scan',    0,                         200, 200, 200 ),
);

$i = 0;
foreach ( $plan as $row ) {
    list( $title, $term, $r, $g, $b ) = $row;
    $path = trailingslashit( $dir['path'] ) . 'uninstall-' . ( ++$i ) . '.png';
    file_put_contents( $path, vgml_png( 320, 240, $r, $g, $b ) );
    $id = wp_insert_attachment( array(
        'post_title'     => $title,
        'post_mime_type' => 'image/png',
        'post_status'    => 'inherit',
    ), $path );
    wp_update_attachment_metadata( $id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $id, $path ) );
    if ( $term ) {
        wp_set_object_terms( $id, array( $term ), 'media_category' );
    }
}

update_option( 'vergeml_uninstall_wipe', '0' );
set_transient( 'vergeml_probe_marker', 1, HOUR_IN_SECONDS );
